space_note: The meshes are defined in MNI305 space (fsaverage surface RAS). Verified by comparing the vertex centroids of all 16 substructures against the centroids of the corresponding labels in 'subjects/fsaverage/mri/aseg.mgz' (label ids 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 26 for lh and 43, 49, 50, 51, 52, 53, 54, 58 for rh), transformed with vox2ras_tkr. All structures agree within 0.3 mm to 2.5 mm (mean about 1 mm).

conversion.note: Format conversion only: vertex coordinates, vertex order and face indices of the source meshes are preserved. The annotation files were created by assigning the 1-based, inclusive vertex ranges from the CSV mapping files to the 8 substructures and coloring them with the standard FreeSurfer 'aseg' colors.

method: ASCII VTK polygon meshes -> FreeSurfer binary triangular surface format (freesurferformats::write.fs.surface). Vertex range mapping -> FreeSurfer annotation file with colortable (freesurferformats::write.fs.annot), subunit colors looked up by name in $FREESURFER_HOME/FreeSurferColorLUT.txt (region name variants like 'Left-Thalamus-Proper' vs. 'Left-Thalamus' are resolved). The written annotation files are read back and verified vertex-wise before being accepted.
